paths.description: Homepage and listing template, including primary navigation, preference conditions, mobile reflow, performance, privacy, security and memory.
Representative category/listing archive selected from primary navigation; represents taxonomy archives.
Representative media detail and playback journey selected from the first homepage card; represents individual video pages.
No-result search journey using a deliberately unmatched query; exercises empty and recovery state.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot is pixel-identical in appearance and byte size to the light capture (245,560 bytes), while the DOM probe finds no color-scheme, prefers-color-scheme, or light-dark() CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven surface, text, control, and media treatment using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Route changes and menu state changes have no View Transition treatment.
findings.evidence: DOM and evaluate probes across all four templates found no view-transition CSS or startViewTransition use; the menu recording contains only a single abrupt state frame.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance same-document menu state and cross-document navigation with View Transitions, preserving an instant fallback.

findings.summary: Very long listing pages provide no scroll-position feedback.
findings.evidence: The mobile homepage is 9,774 CSS pixels tall and the category is 10,224 pixels tall, but probes found no sticky scroll-state query, progress indicator, or related scroll-position affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll progress or position-aware header treatment and preserve reduced-motion behavior.

findings.summary: Login and password overlays are custom hidden markup rather than semantic dialog/popover primitives.
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM contains duplicate login/reset forms and hash-triggered overlay links, but zero dialog, popover, or details elements across templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog for modal authentication flows, declarative commands where supported, explicit labels, focus management, and light-dismiss only where appropriate.

findings.summary: Reusable listing cards adapt only through page-level CSS, with no component-level container behavior.
findings.evidence: The same card template appears in homepage, category and search-result contexts, but all DOM probes found no @container or container-type rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reused card groups an inline-size container and adapt card typography/media layout with container queries while retaining the current viewport fallback.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is usually invisible and several controls are too small.
findings.evidence: The active focus probe found no outline or box shadow on 34 of the first 40 focusable elements on home/category and 38 of 40 on detail. It also found 5 to 9 sampled controls under 44 CSS pixels; Lighthouse flags 24 target-size failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore a strong :focus-visible indicator, avoid blanket outline removal, and enlarge or space compact tabs, voting controls, and tag links to at least a usable touch target.

findings.summary: The empty-search state contradicts itself and does not provide a clear recovery action.
findings.evidence: The search page says “0 video found” and “nothing matched” but immediately renders a long grid of unrelated videos; the screenshot shows no retry field or suggested action in the state block.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the state truthful: either show zero results with a visible search form/suggestions, or label fallback recommendations separately and provide a clear retry action.

findings.summary: Homepage LCP is at or beyond the good Core Web Vitals threshold.
findings.evidence: The DevTools trace measured LCP at 2,853 ms; Lighthouse measured 2.5 s. CLS was excellent and TBT low, so the risk is concentrated in largest-content discovery and delivery.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the true LCP image, avoid lazy-loading it, provide responsive sources, and shorten its dependency path.

findings.summary: Image and critical-resource delivery is substantially wasteful.
findings.evidence: Images probe: 30/32 homepage images oversized, 31/32 without srcset, 27 below-fold images not lazy, and 30 legacy-format images. HAR transferred 720 KB of images and identified parser-blocking styles/scripts; Lighthouse flags LCP discovery.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive variants with srcset/sizes, lazy-load below-fold cards, size logo assets, prioritize only the LCP image, and defer confirmed non-critical scripts.

findings.summary: Unused and third-party code adds avoidable work.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 67 KiB unused JavaScript and 14 KiB unused CSS. The detail page ships 20 scripts and 380,317 third-party bytes, including old Video.js and advertising code.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unused theme/plugin assets per template, conditionally load player code only on detail pages, and reduce or defer advertising/analytics dependencies.

findings.summary: Search and authentication inputs lack reliable accessible names.
findings.evidence: The probe found the visible search input and several login fields without associated labels or aria-label; duplicate hidden login/reset forms repeat the problem. Several image/icon links also have empty text.
findings.suggestedFix: Associate explicit labels with every visible field, give icon-only controls accessible names, remove duplicate inactive forms from the accessibility tree, and verify with axe/Lighthouse.

findings.summary: Text and links fail color-contrast requirements.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports three insufficient foreground/background contrast failures and two cases where links rely on color alone.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG contrast, add a non-color link cue such as underline, and recheck normal, dark, and forced-color conditions.

findings.summary: Heading order and focus treatment do not provide a robust reading/navigation structure.
findings.evidence: Homepage headings begin H2 then H1 and category has two H1 elements; focus is invisible on 34–38 of 40 sampled controls. Main/nav and a skip link do exist.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one page-level H1 followed by sequential headings, preserve the skip link, and apply a consistent visible :focus-visible style in DOM reading order.

findings.summary: Zoom is disabled and the representative video has no captions track.
findings.evidence: Every template declares maximum-scale=1.0 and user-scalable=0; Lighthouse fails meta-viewport. The detail player markup contains a video source but no track element.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable restrictions, preserve reflow at zoom, and provide accurate captions/subtitles or an equivalent transcript for media.

findings.summary: The page uses deprecated APIs and ships incorrectly sized image assets.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports 16 deprecation warnings and an inspector issue. Its responsive-image audit fails, while the image probe finds two images without dimensions and 30 oversized images.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve the recorded deprecations, update or remove stale dependencies, provide explicit intrinsic dimensions, and serve correctly sized responsive assets.

findings.summary: Search-result metadata is incomplete.
findings.evidence: The no-result search template has no meta description and no canonical URL, unlike home/category/detail.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit a concise search-state description and an intentional canonical/indexing policy for search results; avoid accidental duplicate or thin indexing.

findings.summary: The sitemap URL advertised by robots.txt returns HTTP 403.
findings.evidence: robots.txt points to https://zebawy.com/sitemap.xml, but direct request and headers returned 403 Forbidden.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve the advertised sitemap to unauthenticated crawlers with 200, verify its URLs, and keep robots/sitemap/canonical signals consistent.

findings.summary: Core browser security headers are absent and cookies are insecurely scoped.
findings.evidence: Headers probe found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. All three cookies lacked Secure; two analytics cookies used SameSite=None and lasted 400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a tested CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; set Secure and an appropriate SameSite value on every HTTPS cookie.

findings.summary: Advertising and analytics create a large, opaque third-party privacy footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker probe observed 13 third-party origins and known Google trackers. HAR attributed 221,006 third-party bytes on home and 380,317 on detail; advertising domains load before any observed consent choice.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize vendors, delay non-essential analytics/ads until a valid consent basis exists, batch events, and document each retained third party in the privacy notice.

findings.summary: Authentication uses password-only forms without autofill tokens or passkey support.
findings.evidence: DOM probes found password/login fields with no autocomplete values and no WebAuthn or navigator.credentials use; some duplicate login fields are also unlabeled.
findings.suggestedFix: Add username/current-password autocomplete tokens immediately, then offer WebAuthn/passkeys with password fallback and contextual reauthentication.

findings.summary: Detail-page background requests fail without a user-facing recovery state.
findings.evidence: The detail HAR records two 403 responses from wp-admin/admin-ajax.php while the visible page provides no failed-action or retry message.
findings.suggestedFix: Identify the blocked AJAX action, avoid firing it when unavailable, and expose an actionable error/retry state when it affects ratings, login, comments, or playback.

findings.summary: The RTL layout relies on physical left/right CSS rather than logical properties.
findings.evidence: The Arabic document correctly sets lang=ar and dir=rtl, but the homepage/category DOM contains physical left/right rules and the probe finds no logical-property CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace directional margin, padding, inset, border, float, and alignment rules with inline/block logical properties, retaining targeted fallbacks only where needed.

taskList.title: Restore keyboard focus, labels, zoom, target sizing, contrast and captions
Add security headers and secure cookie attributes
Reduce and consent-gate third-party tracking and advertising
Serve responsive modern images and improve LCP/resource priority
Fix truthful empty-search and failed-request recovery states
Modernize authentication semantics, autofill and passkeys
Remove unused/deprecated theme and player assets
Repair sitemap and search metadata/indexing policy
Add preference-aware theme and progressive transitions
Adopt component, scroll-state and RTL logical CSS
